cover.report_type: Interim Report: September 15 (for the period ending September 10, 2014)

_meta.notes: Handwritten 2014 form; September 15 interim checked, neither amendment box checked. On Lines 1 and 2 the cents are written as raised superscripts over a rule ('$47,004' with a superscript '00' etc.) — transcribed with a decimal point. Lines 3-7 are written plainly without the dollar sign. Received stamp SEP 15 2014.

contributions.detail: exact (47004.00 = 47004.00); 161 rows across pp.4-7 sum to the cent and equal the attachment's own highlighted 'TOTAL: $ 47,004.00' on p7

expenditures.detail: exact (37193.81 = 37193.81); 92 rows across pp.9-10 sum to the cent and equal the attachment's own double-ruled total 37,193.81 on p10

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 and p8 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' cells are EMPTY (both schedule bodies read only '- see attached -'), so no per-page subtotal gate exists on the form. The gates that FIRED are the attachments' own grand totals: contributions pp.4-7 rows 47,004.00 = printed 47,004.00; expenditures pp.9-10 rows 37,193.81 = printed 37,193.81.
itemized.escalation_note: no cell escalation needed: both attachments are machine-printed spreadsheet exports that read cleanly at 200 dpi, and each side closed to the cent against its own printed grand total
itemized.notes: 10 pages. p1 cover ('2014 Financial Disclosure Report for County and Local School Board Candidates [County Officeholders - Year-End]'; Jennifer Wilson, Democrat, Office Sought 'Salt Lake County Council At-Large A'; the SEPTEMBER 15 interim box is checked; signed 9/15/14; RECEIVED SEP 15 2014). p2 Summary Page: line1 A $47,004.00 / B $99,181.58; line2 A $37,193.81 / B $55,674.xx; line3 33,696.38; line4 47,004.00; line5 80,700.38; line6 37,193.81; line7 43,506.57. Balance chain CLOSES exactly (33696.38+47004.00=80700.38; 80700.38-37193.81=43506.57). p3 = the 'Itemized Contributions Received' form, body reads '- see attached -'; p8 = the 'Itemized Expenditures Made' form, body reads '- see attached -'. pp.4-7 are LANDSCAPE contribution spreadsheets (rotated 90 CW to read), titled 'September 15 Finance Disclosure Report - Contributions'; pp.9-10 are PORTRAIT expense spreadsheets titled 'Jenny Wilson - Council At-Large A Finance Report September 15, 2014 - Expenses'. The contribution attachment has a REDACTED Street column (solid black bar) but PRINTS City and State in their own columns, so donor_city/donor_state are recorded from those columns; street addresses were discarded at read time and never written. In-kind is marked by an 'x' in the attachment's own 'in-kind' column (4 rows). FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: on each attachment page the count of date cells equals the count of amount cells and equals the count of name rows (49/49, 52/52, 49/49, 11/11, 51/51, 41/41); the Profession/Employer and City cells WRAP onto extra printed lines in several places (Brems/Ingham, Cullimore, Goldsmith/Casper, Anderson/Chambless, Scott/Kanter), which was resolved by aligning on the Date column - no row was assigned a wrapped fragment. One row (8/22/14 Operating Engineers Local Union No. 3 District 12 P...) has its organization name truncated by the redaction bar and is flagged needs_review. Two rows print no City/State at all ('anonymous', and the italic 'Jan Hull'); one row prints a city but no state (IBEW PAC Educational Fund, Washington, D.C.). Expenditure p9 rows are NOT in strict date order near the end (July 26 precedes July 24/25) - kept in printed order.
